subject.title: [Bug]: ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher() breaks COS chunked upload via qqbot plugin

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's global NO_PROXY/enhanced bypass behavior as the core fix for qqbot COS uploads behind proxy env?
rationale: The user-visible regression is real enough to keep open, but the active fix changes process-wide proxy routing and egress expectations, which requires owner acceptance beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept generic core fix after repairs
options.body: Land the linked global dispatcher approach after its reset/docs/security review blockers are repaired and use it as the canonical fix for this issue.

options.title: Narrow the fix surface
options.body: Reject the broader bypass boundary and require a smaller core or plugin transport fix that restores qqbot media upload without changing managed-proxy policy.

options.title: Pause for proxy policy
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers define the permanent managed-proxy and NO_PROXY policy before choosing an implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept generic core fix after repairs
recommendation.body: Land the linked global dispatcher approach after its reset/docs/security review blockers are repaired and use it as the canonical fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent proxy helper and network-proxy work makes this the best available owner for the boundary decision.
